—Welcome to Simbiosis Planet!
For the discerning traveller in search of adventure and insight into the mind, body, spirit connection.
We invite you to join us in an 11 Day Retreat in the Peruvian Amazon and Cusco & Machu Picchu for
journeys incorporating:*Adventure
*Yoga
*Shamanic Healing
*Relaxation
We offer a choice of Two Journeys;
*10 Da) Amazon Rainforest JourneN - http://www.simhiosisplanet.org to view itinerary & journey video
or
*12 Day Explorers Journey - Amazon & Cusco/ Machu Picchu - (See below Itinerary - video available on
website)
The Journeys aim is for individuals to rediscover balance and harmony within their physical and energy bodies
through yoga and shamanic healing and adventure the magical sites of Peru!
Shamanism is a tradition that is centuries old and dates back to our indigenous ancestors.
—'Ayahuasca' is considered the 'Mother of all Medicines' (see following link for info on ayahuasca http://simbiosisplanet.org/shamanisml) by many of the indigenous shamans of the Amazon. It is a purification
process that reaches deep into the subconscious mind and energy body, removing emotional blockages, resulting
in new insights and life awareness. Many participants come away with life altering experiences.
—Imagine learning to live with onefoot in this world and onefoot in the next
—Imagine travelling to many worlds beyond this one and returning to tell the tale.
—Imaginefully experiencing and developing deep respect and connection with the infinitepower ofSpirit.
— Yoga helps develop core strength, with a stronger core and increased flexibility and strength you are more
likely to 'stand tall'. The physical poses called 'asanas' stretch your muscles, releasing the lactic acid that builds
up causing stiffness and fatigue, increasing the range of motion in the joints.
The outcome is a sense of ease and fluidity throughout the body, inducing calmness and tranquility.
—'Pranayamar is a series of breathing techniques which increases vital energy and inducing physical and mental
relaxation.
EXPLORERS JOURNEY -11 DAY RETREAT - 19th - 30th March 2010

EFTA00765046

 AMAZON 7 Days & CUSCO/ MACHU PICCHU 5 Days
£2,300 GBP ($3,760 USD)
Food and board all inclusive. Flights not included.
ITINERARY
* Arrival - From Lima -Peru you will catch a domestic flight to Iquitos, where you will be met by staff at the
airport (morning arrivals are recommended). After breakast in Iquitos you will be taken upriver by boat to the
Refugio Altiplano' (Spanish for High Refuge), where you will stay in a modem private maluka or tree house. All
have bathrooms and are fully screened. Spend the rest of the day settling in.
* Lunch at the Refugio.
* Evening 'Ayahuasca' ceremony.
Days 2 - 7 Mornings begin with a fresh fruit platter and herbal tea that is served at your house.
9am Pranayama - a series of breathing techniques which stimulate and increase vital energy, inducing physical
and mental relaxation.
10.30am Breakfast - in the main building
Daily Activities - You have a choice of various activities to choose from daily;
(Excursion on Day 4)
* Trek through the jungle with a guide
* Kayaking
* Bird watching - The Refugio also has an observation deck above one of the ponds where you can observe
the animals come to drink.
* Visit the botanical gardens with over 500 plant varieties.
* Visit the lagoon or swim in the river - if you are lucky you catch sight of a pink dolphin!
* Contemplate in your hammock with a good book, overlooking spectacular views of the Amazon.
*A sweat lodge is also available for those wanting to relax and assist their body to purge toxins.
2pm Lunch in the main building
17.30pm Iyengar Yoga - Suitable for all levels. Remember to bring your own yoga mat and comfortable
clothing to move and stretch in ( leggings and/or shorts and T-shirts & vest are suitables.)
20.30pm Ayahuasca ceremony commences
Day 4 - A day excursion sightseeing, visiting an authentic indigenous tribe, a butterfly conservatory and
medicinal plant market.
*Lunch at a local restaurant for a traditional Peruvian meal. Back to the Refugio.
* Guests are welcome to explore the nearby town of Tamishakyu to interact with the locals, purchase artisanal
crafts or localpaintings.
Day 7 - Morning Departure from the Amazon. Catching a domestic flight from Iquitos to Cusco. Short
transfer to 3* hotel (luxury Boutique hotel is available at an extra cost) and make our way to an old Inca ruin
'Sacsayhuaman, which translates to' Decorated head of the Puma' - the ruling Palace of the Incas, where the
living God directed people from it's temple. Spend the rest of the day visiting Cusco city around the colonial
Plaza de Armas, the Cathedral and the Temple of the Sun, 'Koricancha'.
Evening - Dinner and overnight in Cusco.
